```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from sklearn.preprocessing import MinMaxScaler


def task_func(data: pd.DataFrame) -> (pd.DataFrame, plt.Axes):
    if not isinstance(data, pd.DataFrame):
        raise TypeError("data must be a pandas DataFrame")

    if data.empty:
        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))
        ax.set_axis_off()
        ax.set_title("Normalized Heatmap")
        return data.copy(), ax

    numeric_data = data.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce")

    try:
        scaler = MinMaxScaler()
        normalized_values = scaler.fit_transform(numeric_data)
        normalized_data = pd.DataFrame(
            normalized_values, index=data.index, columns=data.columns
        )
    except Exception:
        col_min = numeric_data.min(axis=0, skipna=True)
        col_max = numeric_data.max(axis=0, skipna=True)
        denom = (col_max - col_min).replace(0, 1)
        normalized_data = (numeric_data - col_min) / denom

    fig_width = max(6, 0.6 * max(1, normalized_data.shape[1]))
    fig_height = max(4, 0.5 * max(1, normalized_data.shape[0]))
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(fig_width, fig_height))

    if normalized_data.notna().values.any():
        sns.heatmap(
            normalized_data,
            cmap="YlGnBu",
            ax=ax,
            cbar_kws={"label": "Normalized Value"},
        )
        ax.set_title("Normalized Heatmap")
        ax.set_xlabel("")
        ax.set_ylabel("")
    else:
        ax.set_axis_off()
        ax.text(
            0.5,
            0.5,
            "No numeric data available for heatmap",
            ha="center",
            va="center",
            transform=ax.transAxes,
        )

    return normalized_data, ax
```
